observations: Photo 0 shows a stack of dark gray plastic pallets, stacked high on a wooden base, with blue plastic pallets visible to the left and right.
Photo 1 shows a single dark gray plastic pallet from above, revealing a grid-like structure with multiple hollow cells and a central spine.
The pallets appear to be made of heavy-duty plastic, with reinforced edges and structural supports.
There are small white labels on some pallets in photo 0, but the text is not legible.
The ground is unpaved and dusty, suggesting an outdoor storage or yard setting.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the pallets in either photo.

claims.claim: Heavy duty Plastic Pallets available for all types of storage both in shops, home, warehouse, farm,...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show robust plastic pallets with reinforced structure, consistent with heavy-duty use. The design suggests suitability for storage in various environments.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or cracks not visible in photos, especially in the hollow structural parts.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the edges, corners, and internal grid of a single pallet, showing any cracks, warping, or stress marks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or structurally compromised

risks.risk: Pallets may be recycled or reprocessed plastic, affecting durability and load capacity.
risks.proof: Photo of the material texture or a label indicating material type (e.g., HDPE, recycled content).

risks.risk: Pallets may have been previously used and show wear not visible from current angles.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and all four sides of a single pallet, showing any scuffing, dirt buildup, or structural wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly used with unknown wear

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the edges, corners, and internal grid of a single pallet to check for cracks or damage.
Photos of the underside and all four sides of a single pallet to assess wear and condition.
Photo of any labels or markings indicating material type or manufacturer.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as heavy-duty plastic pallets, and the seller's claim is supported by the photos. While there are hidden risks related to damage or material quality, these do not prevent pricing — the item can be priced at its worst-case condition (used, possibly damaged, unknown material) based on visible features.
